items.name: Moon Stone
items.source: Dropped by Vampires during a Solar Eclipse

items.why: Grants a short dash that damages enemies (double-tap a direction).

items.name: Amphibian Boots
items.why: Combines the effects of sprinting boots with the Frog Leg.

items.name: Worm Scarf
items.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Eater of Worlds)
items.why: Reduces all damage taken by 17%.

items.name: Brain of Confusion
items.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Brain of Cthulhu)
items.why: 16.67% chance to dodge an attack when hit, which grants +10% crit and summon damage for 4s; taking damage also has a 60% chance to confuse nearby enemies.

items.name: Star Veil
items.why: Doubles the length of the player's immunity frames (to 4/3 of a second), and summons falling stars when the player is hit.

items.name: Frozen Shield
items.why: Essentially an upgraded version of the Frozen Turtle Shell which provides 6 defense, reduces all damage taken by the player by 25% if the player is below 50% max HP, and grants immunity to knockback.

items.name: Charm of Myths
items.why: Combines the effects of a Philosopher's Stone with a Band of Regeneration:

items.name: Hero Shield
items.why: Provides 10 defense, increases the player's aggro by 400, and provides immunity to knockback.
items.notes: Players seeking to use defensive setups that use the Hero Shield, Flesh Knuckles, and Berserker's Glove simultaneously will need a total of three Flesh Knuckles (or Putrid Scents to shimmer into them). Strongly consider making a place to farm enemies for Souls of Night, as obtaining all three will no doubt be tedious.

items.name: Flesh Knuckles
items.why: Provides 8 defense, and increases the player's aggro by 400.
items.notes: Players seeking to use defensive setups that use the Hero Shield, Flesh Knuckles, and Berserker's Glove simultaneously will need a total of three Flesh Knuckles (or Putrid Scents to shimmer into them). Strongly consider making a place to farm enemies for Souls of Night, as obtaining all three will no doubt be tedious.

items.name: Moon Stone
items.source: Dropped by Vampires during a Solar Eclipse
items.why: In respect to survivability, the Moon Stone increases the player's defense by 4 and health regeneration by 1 HP/s, from 7:30 PM to 4:30 AM.
items.notes: For its varied bonuses, the Moon Stone can be useful for mixed-class users, as it carries significant but broad offensive stats in just one accessory slot. Additionally, players running a defensive loadout that can only use offensive accessories sparingly should prioritize the Moon Stone first and foremost.

items.name: Ankh Shield
items.why: Debuff immunity and knockback protection are especially comforting once Jungle enemies and events get more chaotic.

items.name: Avenger Emblem
items.why: Increases the player's damage by 12%.

items.name: Papyrus Scarab
items.why: Increases summon damage by 15%, the player's minion slots by one, and the knockback of the player's summons. Note that all classes can easily benefit from extra minion damage.

items.name: Spore Sac
items.why: Creates poisonous spores around the player which damage enemies over time.

items.name: Putrid Scent
items.why: Increases damage by 5% and critical strike chance by 5%, and decreases the player's aggro by 400.
items.notes: Players seeking to use defensive setups that use the Hero Shield, Flesh Knuckles, and Berserker's Glove simultaneously will need a total of three Flesh Knuckles (or Putrid Scents to shimmer into them). Strongly consider making a place to farm enemies for Souls of Night, as obtaining all three will no doubt be tedious.

items.name: Sorcerer Emblem
items.why: Increases magic damage by 15%.

items.name: Mana Cloak
items.why: Combines the effects of the Mana Flower and Star Cloak. Additionally, the stars produced by the Star Cloak will transform into special mana stars, which restore 50 mana to the player.

items.name: Magnet Flower
items.why: Reduces mana cost by 8% and enables the player to collect mana stars more easily.
items.effect: 8% reduced mana cost · Automatically use mana potions when needed · Increases pickup range for mana stars

items.name: Mana Flower
items.why: Auto-potions reduce cognitive load and keep your strongest spells online more consistently.
items.effect: 8% reduced mana cost · Automatically use mana potions when needed

weapons.name: Deadly Sphere Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Deadly Spheres during a Solar Eclipse
weapons.why: Summons orbiting Deadly Sphere minions that dash at enemies.

weapons.name: Desert Tiger Staff
weapons.source: Found in the Dungeon's Desert Chest, unlocked with a Desert Key after Plantera
weapons.why: Summons a single Desert Tiger minion that grows stronger with additional summons.

weapons.name: Terraprisma
weapons.source: Dropped by the Empress of Light if all damage is dealt during the day
weapons.why: Summons homing sword minions; Empress is fought via a post-Plantera Prismatic Lacewing.

weapons.name: Kaleidoscope
weapons.source: Dropped by the Empress of Light (summoned after Plantera)
weapons.why: Empress of Light drop giving one of the largest summon tag damage bonuses.

weapons.name: Morning Star
weapons.source: Dropped by Armored Bones enemies in the post-Plantera Hardmode Dungeon
weapons.why: A flail that gains critical strike chance with combos.

weapons.name: Pygmy Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Plantera
weapons.why: Summons Pygmy minions that inflict Acid Venom.

weapons.name: Raven Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by the Pumpking during the Pumpkin Moon
weapons.why: Summons Raven minions; obtained from the post-Plantera Pumpkin Moon event.

weapons.name: Staff of the Frost Hydra
weapons.source: Found in the Dungeon's Ice Chest, opened with a Frozen Key (post-Plantera)
weapons.why: Post-Plantera sentry summoning a Frost Hydra that fires piercing frost blasts.

weapons.name: Dark Harvest
weapons.source: Dropped by Pumpking during the Pumpkin Moon
weapons.why: Pumpking drop whose swings can hit multiple times with a strong summon tag.

weapons.name: Vulgar Display of Flower
weapons.source: Dropped by Plantera
weapons.why: Plantera drop that briefly boosts minion and whip damage after striking.

weapons.name: Queen Spider Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: Early Hardmode sentry summoning a Spider Turret that lobs bouncing egg projectiles.

weapons.name: Ballista Cane
weapons.source: Bought from the Tavernkeep after defeating one mechanical boss (tier 2)
weapons.why: Tier 2 Tavernkeep upgrade of the ballista bolt sentry.

weapons.name: Firecracker
weapons.source: Dropped by the Wall of Flesh
weapons.why: Wall of Flesh drop whose tag detonates for a large burst of minion damage.

weapons.name: Optic Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: Summons Twins (Retanimini and Spazmamini) as one minion.

weapons.name: Blade Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Queen Slime
weapons.why: Summons Enchanted Dagger minions with low base damage that ignore 25 defense, scaling on flat/tag bonuses.

weapons.name: Spider Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: Summons Spider minions that inflict Acid Venom.

weapons.name: Durendal
weapons.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: A whip with fast use time that boosts minion attack speed.

weapons.name: Sanguine Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Dreadnautilus (Blood Moon fishing in Hardmode)
weapons.why: Summons fast Sanguine Bat minions.

weapons.name: Pirate Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Pirates and the Flying Dutchman during the Pirate Invasion
weapons.why: Summons a Pirate minion.

armor.name: Tiki Armor
armor.source: Bought from the Witch Doctor after Plantera
armor.effect: +30% summon damage · +30% whip range · +4 minion slots

armor.name: Spooky Armor
armor.why: Summon damage +25%, the highest before Lunar gear.
armor.effect: +58% summon damage · +4 minion slots · +20% movement speed · A visual glowing effect around the player.

accessories.name: Hercules Beetle
accessories.source: Purchased from the Witch Doctor
accessories.why: Increases knockback of the player's summons as well as their damage by 15%.

accessories.name: Berserker's Glove
accessories.source: Crafted at Tinkerer's Workshop

accessories.name: Pygmy Necklace
accessories.source: Bought from the Witch Doctor at night.
accessories.why: +1 minion slot.

accessories.name: Terraspark Boots
accessories.source: Combined through the full boots crafting chain
accessories.why: Super-fast running and flight, with lava, water, and honey walking plus ice mobility.

accessories.name: Mothron Wings
accessories.source: Dropped by Mothron during a Solar Eclipse
accessories.why: Allows the player to fly briefly and glide (and negates fall damage).

accessories.name: Master Ninja Gear
accessories.source: Combined at the Tinkerer's Workshop
accessories.why: Dash, wall climbing, and a 10% chance to dodge an attack.

buffs.why: Increases your maximum number of minions by 1.

buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
